description: The bar chart illustrates the financial performance of two entities, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our), in a financial QA-2 evaluation. The horizontal axis represents the entities, while the vertical axis indicates the percentage of correct, partially correct, and incorrect answers. EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 has a correct answer rate of 92.9%, a partially correct rate of 2.9%, and an incorrect rate of 4.3%. RedWhale (our) has a higher correct answer rate of 95.7%, a lower partially correct rate of 1.4%, and an incorrect rate of 2.9%. The chart uses three colors to represent the different categories: dark blue for correct, medium blue for partially correct, and light blue for incorrect. The values are represented by the length of the bars, with the longest bar indicating the highest percentage of correct answers.
